name: SABRE
summary: SABRE develops low-background NaI(Tl) dark-matter observations in both hemispheres. Their seasons are opposite while the expected Galactic-signal phase is the same, helping test environmental variations and the dark-matter interpretation of DAMA's annual modulation.
detection_principle: High-purity crystals and low-background optical readout measure annual variations in low-energy events. The northern and southern detectors use different shielding schemes; their original common design must not be assumed to describe identical present configurations.

key_parameters.value: North uses fully passive shielding; South retains an active anticoincidence design.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
